mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as investors allocate capital to risk assets during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as consumer spending expectations decline.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises by >0.1pp monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above 3-month moving averages indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS and HOUST above 3-month MA fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDP growth >3% annualized and unemployment <4.5%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO declines in the late-cycle regime.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1300 thousand units indicates strong residential demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as consumer spending accelerates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1300.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.25 percentage points signals monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises by >0.25pp monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicate strong labor market conditions with accommodative policy, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
regime_hint: strong labor market with accommodative policy
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE < 4.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5% fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2%) combined with strong consumer demand (RSAFS > 1000) triggers fears of aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation with strong consumer demand
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2% and RSAFS > 1000.
